answers.reason: Accepted: 安らかな modifies 日, not a third coordinated noun; keeping {t:rest} there conflates 安らかさ with 安息 and breaks the grammar.

notes: Removed {t:rest} from p20-s4 only; {t:rest} in p20-s3 for 安らかさ is retained.
